description:
Return a single frame from a prior recording at FULL RESOLUTION, as an image. The contact sheet from `record` is a downscaled overview; when it is too small to read fine detail or small text, call this with the recording's directory and the frame number (both are listed in the `record` response), or with a direct frame path. This works over MCP without filesystem access.
To ZOOM IN on part of a frame, pass `crop`. Easiest is a normalized rectangle — fractions 0..1 of the frame — so you can target a region you see on the contact sheet without knowing the exact pixel size: e.g. {"normalized":true,"x":0.5,"y":0,"w":0.5,"h":0.5} is the top-right quadrant. The crop is returned at full resolution, so a small UI detail becomes legible without transferring the whole frame.

crop.description: Optional sub-rectangle to return at full resolution. Omit to get the whole frame.

h.description: Crop height (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default: to the bottom edge.

normalized.description: When true, x/y/w/h are fractions of the frame (0..1). When false/omitted, they are pixels.

w.description: Crop width (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default: to the right edge.

x.description: Left edge of the crop (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default 0.

y.description: Top edge of the crop (fraction if normalized, else pixels). Default 0.

dir.description: Recording directory from a `record` result (its "dir" / "Frames saved under" path).

index.description: 1-based frame number to fetch (e.g. 4 for frame #004). Required when using `dir`.

path.description: Direct path to a frame PNG, as an alternative to dir + index.

name: get_frame
